QuotrPro - AI Estimates for Contractors | Snap Photos, Get Prices

# Win the quote before you leave the driveway.

Snap photos. Get a priced estimate in minutes. From your phone, on the spot.

3 days free · No credit card · iPhone

500+ contractors· 50 states·$2.4M+ quoted

Local prices in every U.S. zip · 100,000+ stores

## Three steps. Five minutes. Done before you leave the job.

### Snap the photos.

Five to seven shots from your phone. The whole space, the rough edges, the access. That’s all the AI needs to start.

### Answer 5–8 questions.

The AI asks what a 30-year contractor would ask: original material, hidden damage, finish grade, timeline. Tap a, b, c, or d. Hand the phone to the homeowner. They finish it in a minute.

### Get a priced estimate.

Real local material prices. Real labor rates for your metro. Line items, totals, a professional proposal. Ready to sign right there on the phone.

## Where the prices come from.

Not made up. From the places you actually shop, with data you can verify line by line.

### Home Depot + Lowe’s

Fresh from your local store by zip code. 1,776 Home Depot stores nationwide. Same as walking in to buy it yourself.

### Local wages in every U.S. zip

Pay rates set for your metro from public wage data. An NYC carpenter doesn’t cost what a rural carpenter costs. The price reflects that.

### Beyond the big-box shelf

Custom builds, luxury fixtures, contractor-grade materials, dumpster fees, permit costs. What HD and Lowe’s don’t carry, we look up from local suppliers. No blanks on your quote.

## Four checks before a price hits your proposal.

Every price passes four checks before it lands on your quote. Real prices, double-checked, backed by decades of trade pricing data.

### Local store search

Real product, real local price, by your zip code.

### AI picks the right product

Picks the right one when there are ten options. Wrong brand, wrong size, wrong style. Tossed.

### Double-check for mistakes

A second pass checks every price for obvious mistakes. The kind you’d miss when you’re rushing.

### 30 years of trade pricing

When the stores don’t carry it, the price comes from decades of contractor cost data. Anchored to your region, not guessed.

A $2,485 deck or a $25,000 kitchen remodel. Minutes, not hours.

Snap the room. Type a few words. AI shows the “after” in seconds. Send it with the quote. They drag the slider on their phone and the deal closes itself.

## Quick answers.

The stuff contractors ask us first.

Will this work for my trade?

Yes. Handymen, remodelers, electricians, plumbers, painters, roofers, HVAC, and every other residential trade. We know what each trade orders, who runs the crew, and how long it takes.

Are the prices right for my zip code?

Real local prices for your zip. Standard, contractor-grade, premium, custom work like stainless counters or built-in cabinets, dumpster rental, permit fees. All of it. Close enough to send on the first try, with a line or two to tighten before you do.

Can I change the estimate before sending it?

Yes, every line. The AI does the first pass in five minutes. You make it yours before the customer ever sees it.

Does my customer need an app to sign or pay the deposit?

No. They tap a link, sign with their finger, pay the deposit on the same page. No app, no account, nothing to download.

Is my customer’s info safe?

Yours alone. We only use it to make your quote. Never sold, never shared with anyone else.

What happens to my old quotes if I cancel?

You keep them. View or download any time, even after you cancel. Nothing held hostage.

I already have a way to quote. Why switch?

Most of ours did too. Run it on your next three quotes alongside how you do it now. If ours isn’t faster, you walk.

## Win one more job a month. The price pays for itself.
